findings.reason: Not a credential: base-copies.json line 2363 records the SHA-256 of the Base copy src/modules/dependencies/auth.mjs (Base e881e6f66ce7cd737d17dbeb945995aab83c30d8 modules/dependencies/auth.mjs), equal to the committed file. Gitleaks 8.30.1 dir mode starts a fragment at byte 125000, mid-line, and reports the hit's column (12) from that fragment instead of the line (35), so the identity binding cannot place the digest at its copies/files location.
